summary: Adds an evidence-ledger-centered PACT harness variant that emphasizes falsifiable root-cause hypotheses, predicted impact, risk tracking, next-round attribution, and artifact-first review.
meaningful_difference: Unlike humanize-inspired-v1, this variant does not center BitLesson or RLCR ceremony. It requires each worker and reviewer claim to be tied to an evidence ledger, checked against artifacts, and carried forward as confirmed, falsified, or unresolved predictions.
